summary: SEALSQ Corp filed a Form 6-K on June 4, 2026, announcing two acquisitions: a majority equity stake in WeCan Group and a 100% acquisition of Miraex SA. SEALSQ will invest CHF 5 million in WeCan, building on an initial 28% stake. Terms for Miraex were not disclosed. Both are strategic to advancing post-quantum security and quantum interconnect layers. No board recommendation or advisors named. The transactions are expected to close; regulatory milestones and integration risks are key. Risk-arb angle: monitor integration success and forward-looking statements about QOSC program.
